format: WSDC age-based Jack and Jill contests

source.edition: Version 2026.1C (page footers; the file name says 2026.1B)
source.quote_free_summary: Juniors are younger than 18, Sophisticated 35 or older and Masters 50 or older, each by the close of the event; one contest of each kind records points and these contests are open to all skill levels who meet the age requirement.

requirement: Competition OS does not compute WSDC age. The WSDC age_basis would record close_of_event with the stated thresholds; what instant 'close of the event' is remains unresolved. WSDC Junior contests are unreachable while OD-02 stands.
enforcement_point: Not built. Design only (docs/competition/governance/editions/OD-30-rulebook-editions-design.md). The OD-03/OD-18 organizer determination is the only age-division control at first activation.
interpretation_notes: EFFECTIVE DATE UNKNOWN: effective_from is a schema-required PLACEHOLDER (the date the governance registry was introduced), NOT a verified effective date; no pinned source states one (OD-30 finding F-1). 'Close of the event' not defined (OD30-SILENT-0002). Same wording in the 2027 draft, which is 'not current'. Coordinates with WSDC-OD03-AGE-AT-CLOSE (PR #837).
